title: EvSchema
description: EV Finder catalogue schema v0. Single source of truth: TS and Python types are generated from this file. Stable ids never change; slugs may.

Country.description: Launch countries (Decision 066 adds ES and IT).

QualityTier.description: checked = staff hand-checked; sourced = 2+ agreeing sources; single-source = one source only.

RealRangeRung.description: Which rung of the real-range fallback ladder produced the value (highest first).

licence.description: SPDX id or licence name, e.g. CDLA-Permissive-2.0, CC0-1.0.

abrp_typecode.description: ABRP car model code for deep links (Decision 012); null = plain ABRP link.

abrp_deprecated.description: ABRP lists abrp_typecode as deprecated (old codes still work in the planner, R-24).

abrp_replaced_by.description: ABRP's replacement typecode when abrp_typecode is deprecated (R-24). An ABRP code, not a variant id: renamed or merged variants go in Catalogue.retired_ids.

FactField.description: Fact field names. Enum-valued facts are checked at release time, not here (an if/then on Fact breaks the generated TS type): iso15118_20_support → Iso15118Support (yes/no/not-disclosed, default not-disclosed, never inferred); heat_pump → HeatPumpFitment; drag_coefficient → Cd 0-1. Units: frontal_area_m2 m², kerb_mass_kg kg (kerb weight without driver; mass in running order is mass_running_order_kg, Decision 023), wheel_size_in = rim diameter code. Usable battery is battery_kwh_net (no separate usable_kwh field).

value.description: Scalar, or a ChargeCurve when field = dc_curve.

unit.description: Metric unit (kWh, km, kW, kWh/100km, l, mm, kg, s, km/h, count) or currency code for prices.

source_record.description: Pointer to the raw record, e.g. a file path or row key.

claim.description: true when the value is a maker claim rather than measured.

derived.description: true when computed by us from other facts.

agreeing_sources.description: Number of independent sources agreeing within the field tolerance (UI badge 'N sources agree').

estimate.description: true when the value comes from a model/ratio rather than any source.

PublishedVariant.description: One wide row per variant per release. What the web app reads.

epa_range_km.description: EPA (US 5-cycle) range in km, from fueleconomy.gov / OpenEV. Its own field: agreement is only ever counted against other EPA figures, never against WLTP (T-059).

epa_range_hwy_km.description: EPA highway range, km (R-28). The EPA highway cycle is not 120 km/h motorway driving.

consumption_epa_kwh_100km.description: EPA label consumption (combined), kWh/100 km, wall basis. Separate from the WLTP consumption_kwh_100km (R-28).

ac_kw_optional.description: Optional bigger on-board charger, kW (Decision 034, T-063). ac_kw stays the standard one; null = no option or not known.

ac_full_charge_h.description: EPA 240 V empty-to-full charge time, hours (R-28). Info only; never used to derive ac_kw.

dc_km_per_10min.description: Derived: km added in 10 min at motorway consumption (dc_avg_10_80_kw / motorway consumption * 100 / 6).

real_range_winter_km.description: Derived estimate (T-072): km on a full usable battery at -5 °C and colder, mixed driving, from the consumption matrix. The temperature step is not validated by winter road tests yet (Q-059).

frunk_l.description: Front boot, litres. 0 = no frunk; null = not known.

registered_count_nl.description: RDW registrations, counted at generation level.

provenance.description: Field name → where the value came from. Every non-null number above must have an entry.

dc_km_per_20min.description: Derived: km added in 20 min at motorway consumption. Used for the DC ranking.

dc_peak_kw_is_claim.description: true when dc_peak_kw is a maker claim, not measured.

fast_on_400v.description: Derived: native 400 V car, or booster/limited at >= 50 kW on 400 V chargers.

registrations.description: Per country: official counts (fleet and/or new registrations).

abrp_typecode.description: ABRP car model code; null = plain ABRP link.

abrp_replaced_by.description: ABRP's replacement typecode when abrp_typecode is deprecated (R-24).

iso15118_20_support.description: Car-side ISO 15118-20. Default not-disclosed; never inferred.

bidi.description: Bidirectional capabilities incl. rows inherited from the platform; keyed by model_years and per-country market_status.

ports.description: Charging inlets per market and model-year range.

heat_pump.description: Heat pump: standard / option / none / not-disclosed.

one_pedal.description: One-pedal driving (T-066). null = not in the data yet; not-disclosed = looked for, not stated.

regen_paddles.description: Steering-wheel paddles to change regen strength (T-066).

lookalike_group_ids.description: Look-alike groups this variant is in (Catalogue.lookalike_groups); empty or absent = none known.

clue_count.description: Number of clues for this variant in Catalogue.variant_clues, so the web app can skip the 'spot it' box without loading clues.

shortlist_score.description: Profile combination → score 0..100 (T-069). Editorial opinion, not fact.

shortlist_unknown_factors.description: Profile combination → factors / gates without data.

nedc_range_km.description: NEDC range (old EU cycle). Never used to fill WLTP.

wltp_range_km_worst.description: Worst-case WLTP range of the type approval (wltp_range_km is the best case or the single stated value).

mass_running_order_kg.description: Mass in running order (incl. 75 kg driver), as in type approval; weight_kg stays kerb weight.

used_prices.description: Optional; empty until a licensed used-price source exists (T-056).

ChargeCurve.description: DC charge curve: list of (state of charge %, kW) points plus test conditions.

VoltageClass.description: Row in data/taxonomy/voltage_classes.yaml. Data, not an enum: add a row, no code change.

label.description: Display label. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

label.description: Display label. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

items.description: One pro. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.
One con. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.
One tip. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

charge_100_daily.description: true = maker guidance allows charging to 100% daily (typical for LFP). null = unclear.

first_year.description: First year in a series-production passenger EV.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

label.description: Display label. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

label.description: Plain-language label. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

short.description: Tooltip text, at most 20 words. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

long.description: Learn-page text. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

nerd_note.description: Extra detail for Nerd mode. Keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

owner.description: Group that owns the platform, e.g. Volkswagen Group.

BatteryPack.description: A battery pack shared by one or more variants. Variants inherit its facts unless they have their own measured fact.

Charger400vBehaviour.description: How an 800 V+ car behaves on older 400 V DC chargers.

kw.description: Max kW on a 400 V charger (booster or limited).

switchable.description: Pack can switch between 400 and 800 V.

RegistrationCount.description: One official count for a country. Kinds are not added together.

kind.description: fleet = cars on the road (stock); new_registrations = first registrations in the period.

level.description: Level the count was matched at; model-level counts repeat on every generation.

LocalizedText.description: Text keyed by language (en, nl, de, fr, es, it); en required.

CountryCode.description: Any market as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, except UK for the United Kingdom (same as Country). Wider than Country so US/AU/NZ/CA rows (Phase 4) need no schema change; checked against config at release time.

BidiMode.description: Row in data/taxonomy/bidi_modes.yaml (v2l, v2h, v2g, v2b). Decision 011.

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

BidiRoute.description: Row in data/taxonomy/bidi_routes.yaml (ac-onboard, dc-offboard, chademo-dc, proprietary).

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

inverter_location.description: Where the inverter sits; decides the home box price (R-01 §3).

needs_special_box.description: true = needs a bidirectional box beyond a normal wallbox.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

BidiProtocol.description: Row in data/taxonomy/bidi_protocols.yaml (iso15118-20, iso15118-2-ext, chademo, proprietary, not-disclosed).

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

standard.description: Formal standard name, e.g. 'EN ISO 15118-20:2022'. Nerd mode.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

BidiCaveat.description: Row in data/taxonomy/bidi_caveats.yaml. The UI shows caveats only from this table, never free text. label/short may contain '{param}', filled from BidiCaveatRef.param.

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

param_kind.description: Type of the optional parameter a capability row may pass.

param_unit.description: Metric unit of a number param, e.g. kWh.

severity.description: condition = shown as an eligibility condition, never a plain tick.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

BidiStatus.description: Row in data/taxonomy/bidi_status.yaml (live, pilot, announced, hardware-ready-not-enabled, not-offered, not-disclosed).

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

filter_group.description: live matches the default filter; pilot-or-announced only with 'Include pilots and announced'.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

ConnectorType.description: Row in data/taxonomy/connector_types.yaml (type1-j1772, type2, ccs1, ccs2, nacs-j3400, chademo, tesla-eu-legacy, gbt-ac, gbt-dc).

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

regions.description: Where it is common, e.g. 'EU', 'US', 'JP' (display hint, not a rule).

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

PriceBandEur.description: Price band in euros (converted at display time). Euros internally (AGENTS.md units).

note.description: e.g. list vs intro price, original currency.

BidiEquipment.description: Row in data/taxonomy/bidi_equipment.yaml: an approved bidirectional box. New boxes are new rows.

source_ids.description: Ids of rows in the catalogue sources list.

Iso15118Support.description: Car-side ISO 15118-20 support. Default not-disclosed; never inferred from model year (Decision 011).

param.description: Optional parameter, typed by the caveat row's param_kind (number, ISO date, version string).

BidiMarketStatus.description: Status of one capability in one country. Older than 90 days = 'may be out of date'.

since.description: Date the status started (launch date), if known.

source_ids.description: Ids of rows in the catalogue sources list.

checked_at.description: Last date a source confirmed this status.

tariff_names.description: Required energy contracts in this country, e.g. 'Mobilize Power'.

caveats.description: Country-only caveats, added to the capability caveats.

BidiCapability.description: One bidirectional mode for a variant, or for a platform (inherited by its variants). Decision 011, spec bidirectional-and-connectors §3.2. Eligibility is shown as conditions, never a plain tick, whenever min_software, min_battery_net_kwh or build_date_from is set.

protocol_id.description: bidi_protocols id (the table has a not-disclosed row).

model_years.description: Model years covered; empty or absent = all years of the subject.

tariff_required.description: A specific energy contract is needed (names per country in market_status).

market_status.description: Country → status. A country that is absent means not known (shown as not disclosed).

eligibility_url.description: Maker's eligibility page (used-car checklist deep link).

source_ids.description: Ids of rows in the catalogue sources list.

notes.description: Internal note; never shown as a caveat.

from_connector_id.description: connector_types id of the station side.

to_connector_id.description: connector_types id of the car side.

ChargingPort.description: Charging inlets of a variant per market and model-year range (US ports switch CCS1 → NACS by model year).

dc_inlet_id.description: connector_types id; null = no DC charging.

native_or_adapter.description: Whether the listed DC connector is the car's own inlet or reached through an included adapter.

supercharger_access.description: (US) Can it use Tesla Superchargers, and how.

source_ids.description: Ids of rows in the catalogue sources list.

ChargingArea.description: A country, or an aggregate area for EAFO (EU27, EUROPE) and IEA (WORLD) series.

ChargingMetric.description: Row in data/taxonomy/charging_metrics.yaml (public-points, public-points-dc, installed-kw, evs-per-point, ...). Decision 012.

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

unit.description: Metric unit: count, kW, %, per 100k people, EVs per point, kW per EV.

derived.description: true when we compute it (ratios) rather than read it from a source.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

ChargingDefinition.description: Row in data/taxonomy/charging_definitions.yaml: how one source counts (afir-recharging-point, uk-dft-evse-2026, ...). A chart draws one definition; a new definition starts a new series with a marked break.

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

counts.description: Unit counted: a point is not a device is not a location is not a connector.

fast_label.description: The source's own word for 'fast' (Nerd mode), e.g. 'Schnellladepunkt (>22 kW)'.

replaced_by.description: Definition that continues the series after a break.

comparable_across_countries.description: true only for EAFO / IEA definitions.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

PowerBand.description: Row in data/taxonomy/power_bands.yaml. Our bands (AC <22 kW, AC 22 kW, DC 50-149, DC 150-349, DC 350+) plus each source's own bands, mapped to ours with maps_to.

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

ours.description: true = one of our display bands.

source_id.description: Set for a source's own band.

maps_to.description: Our band ids this source band falls into (one when it maps cleanly).

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

ChargingStat.description: One aggregate number per country (or region), date, metric and power band. Never point-level data. Decision 012.

region.description: Sub-national region (e.g. a German state), null = whole country.

source_label.description: The source's own label for the figure (Nerd mode).

CountryChargingLink.description: Row in config: the 'Find a charger / plan a trip' link-out block. Pure links, no API calls. Decision 012.

country.description: ALL = pan-European / global tool shown everywhere.

deep_link_template.description: URL template with {placeholders}, e.g. ABRP car model; null = plain link.

RoadBand.description: The three route bands of the consumption matrix (Decision 013): town ≤50 km/h, rural 60-90, motorway 100+.

HeatPumpFitment.description: option = fitted on some cars only; for used cars show both cases until the owner confirms.

ConsumptionRung.description: Fallback ladder rung (trip-fit §5): measured for this variant → same platform/pack scaled → physics → WLTP × class ratio.

RoadClass.description: Row in data/taxonomy/road_classes.yaml: OSM highway tags → road band.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

osm_highway.description: OSM highway=* values, e.g. motorway, trunk, residential.

max_speed_kmh.description: Typical limit when the way has no maxspeed tag.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

BandSpeeds.description: Typical driving speed per road band, km/h.

SpeedProfile.description: Row in data/taxonomy/speed_profiles.yaml: typical speeds per road band for one country (NL 100 by day, FR 130, DE advisory 130, UK 70 mph).

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

style_offset_kmh.description: Offset applied per driving style; spec default -10 / 0 / +10.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

TemperatureBand.description: Row in data/taxonomy/temperature_bands.yaml: one of the matrix temperature columns (5 at launch).

representative_c.description: Temperature the matrix cell is computed at.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

HeaterType.description: Row in data/taxonomy/heater_types.yaml (heat-pump, resistive, unknown) with its default temperature curve.

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

temperature_curve.description: (ambient °C, consumption factor vs 20 °C) points; a car's own winter test replaces it.

warm_up_kwh.description: Energy per cold start (cabin + battery); dropped when preheated on the plug.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

UsageProfile.description: Row in data/taxonomy/usage_profiles.yaml and in shortlist_rules.yaml profiles / addons: one profile type for Trip fit (weights, trip-fit §6) and the shortlist (gates, factors, bands, Decision 038). A new row, not new code. kind addon = ticked extra on top of a base profile.

aliases.description: Older ids that still resolve to this row (URLs, saved profiles).

applies_when.description: Picker answers that select this profile: question id → accepted answer ids.

picker.description: shortlist_rules.yaml spelling of applies_when (same meaning). New rows: use applies_when.

matches_usage_profile.description: Transitional: the usage_profiles row this shortlist profile maps to, until both live in one table (T-066).

combines_with.description: Overlay profile (e.g. kerbside-charger): applied on top of these base profiles.

weights.description: Factor → weight (price, efficiency, dc_km_20min_winter, winter_1000km_time, ac_speed, battery_risk ...).

weight_steps.description: Add-ons, modifiers and overlays: factor id → steps up (+) or down (-), e.g. battery-health-risk +1. One step = × weight_step_factor, then renormalised.

extra_factors.description: Overlays and add-ons: factors added to the base profile's.

prefer.description: Soft preference: PublishedVariant field → preferred values (sorts up, never filters).

sort_default.description: Default Explore sort for this profile, e.g. price_used_asc.

not_rules.description: What the owner cares about but is deliberately not scored.

calibration.description: How the thresholds were checked (back-test, research).

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

ConsumptionTest.description: One condition-tagged consumption measurement (Bjørn Nyland 90/120 km/h, ADAC, NAF El Prix ...). Input to ConsumptionModel.

test_kind.description: constant-speed = steady speed run; route = mixed real route; cycle = lab cycle.

speed_kmh.description: Constant speed, or average speed for a route.

road_band.description: Band the test represents, if a single one.

band_km.description: Route tests: km per road band.

wheel_size_in.description: Rim diameter code (ISO/ETRTO designation, inches by convention).

energy_basis.description: battery = from the car's own meter / SoC; wall = includes charging losses.

range_km.description: Range result, if the test reports one.

source.description: Full Source in staging files; a SourceRef inside consumption_matrix.json (the file lists the Sources once).

ConsumptionCell.description: One road band × temperature band cell.

heater_type_id.description: Set when the variant has the heat pump as an option: one cell set per heater case.

test_ids.description: ConsumptionTest ids behind a measured cell.

ConsumptionModel.description: Derived per-variant consumption matrix (3 road bands × temperature bands), static JSON per release. The browser scores trips with it.

model_version.description: Version of the model code that built it.

warm_up_kwh.description: Per cold start; overrides the heater_types default.

regen_recovery.description: Share of climb energy recovered downhill (~0.6).

ClimateNormal.description: Climate normals for one town or grid cell (Meteostat / ERA5). Town ids from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

FinanceProduct.description: Kind of finance a FinanceProfile row describes. pcp = personal contract purchase (balloon at the end; UK, similar to FR LOA).

FinanceSource.description: Where a FinanceProfile figure comes from. Central-bank statistics only for typical_apr (Decision 017).

name.description: Publisher and dataset, e.g. 'ECB Data Portal, MFI interest rate statistics'.

licence.description: Reuse terms as stated by the publisher; '(to confirm)' if not checked.

series_title.description: The publisher's own title for the series (Nerd mode).

period.description: Observation period of the figure: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

FinanceProfile.description: Row in data/taxonomy/finance_profiles.yaml: typical finance terms per country and product, read by the price-mode calculator (Decision 017). null = no citable figure; the calculator asks the user instead of guessing.

typical_apr.description: Typical annual percentage rate of charge, in percent (8.91 = 8.91 %). null = no citable source; the calculator asks for a rate.

default_term_months.description: Sourced typical term; null = no source, the calculator uses its own labelled default.

default_deposit_pct.description: Sourced typical deposit as percent of the price; null = no source.

source.description: Required (not null) whenever typical_apr has a value.

retrieved_at.description: When the source was read. Required (not null) whenever typical_apr has a value.

notes.description: Staff notes: caveats, why a value is null, what the figure does and does not cover.

review.description: true = entered by an agent or not yet checked by a person; goes to the review queue.

ClueStrength.description: How far a clue settles which variant it is (variant finder spec §3). decisive = on its own it separates the variant from every look-alike in rules_out; strong = usually settles it but sources or ads can be wrong; weak = a hint only (e.g. battery kWh in ads, often wrong).

ClueValueKind.description: Shape of the value a clue of this type carries. number / text / code / boolean use VariantClue.value; number-range and date-range use VariantClue.range. code = an identifier matched as written (type-approval code, VIN character).

ClueFoundIn.description: Where a buyer finds the clue: ad text, ad photos, registration papers, on the car itself, or the VIN.

ClueType.description: Row in data/taxonomy/clue_types.yaml (build-date-range, power-kw, battery-kwh, trim-name, type-approval-code, vin-position, visible-feature, onboard-charger, ...). Decision 019, variant finder spec §3-4. A new clue type is a new row, no code change; clue_type_id values are checked against this table at release time (Decision 010 pattern).

technical.description: Technical name shown under the plain label.

short.description: Tooltip text, at most 20 words (e.g. 'What is the type-approval code?').

explainer.description: Plain-language explainer for /learn and Detailed mode.

unit.description: Metric unit for number values (kW, kWh, in for rim size code); absent for text, code and date values.

found_in.description: Where a buyer can read it, most useful first.

paper_fields.description: Country → field on that country's registration papers or open registration data, e.g. FR 'P.2', NL 'vermogen (RDW)'. Absent country = not on the papers there or not checked.

ask_seller.description: Copyable 'ask the seller' line template (six languages, spec §5). May contain '{value}' or '{variant}', filled by the web app.

default_strength.description: Typical strength of this clue type; each VariantClue still states its own.

order.description: Display order in the 'spot it in an ad' box.

glossary_id.description: Glossary term for the ⓘ tooltip, if any.

ClueRange.description: Inclusive range. Numbers for number-range clue types; ISO year-month ('2021-06') or date ('2021-06-14') for date-range types. null = open-ended on that side.

max.description: Upper bound (inclusive); null = open (e.g. still built).

ClueSourceRef.description: One piece of evidence for a clue: a row in the catalogue sources list plus the exact page where the clue was read.

source_id.description: Id of a row in the catalogue sources list.

url.description: Exact page (maker brochure, press release, registration-data docs). Required for staff-entered clues (checked at release time).

locator.description: Where on the page or in the document, e.g. 'p. 12, technical data table'. No copied tables.

source_record.description: Pointer to a raw record, for pipeline-derived clues.

VariantClue.description: One fact a buyer can read in an ad, on the registration papers or on the car that points to this variant (Decision 019, variant finder spec §3-4). Set exactly one of value or range (checked at release time, together with the value shape against the clue type's value_kind). The same rows feed listing matching later (spec §8).

clue_type_id.description: clue_types id (data/taxonomy/clue_types.yaml), checked at release time.

market.description: Country where the clue holds (trim names, paper fields), or 'global'.

value.description: Single value for number / text / code / boolean clue types. Trim names are stored as written in that market, never translated.

range.description: For number-range and date-range clue types.

unit.description: Metric unit when value or range is a number; must match the clue type's unit.

position.description: Character position (1-based) for VIN-position clue types.

description.description: Buyer-facing detail for visible-feature clues, e.g. 'heat-pump pipe left of the front motor'. Not for trim names.

rules_out.description: Variant ids this clue rules out; they must exist and share a look-alike group with variant_id (checked at release time).

lookalike_group_id.description: Group the clue separates within, when the variant is in more than one.

sources.description: Evidence; two or more where possible.

retrieved_at.description: Last date a source confirmed the clue.

fact_ids.description: Facts the clue is derived from, if any (e.g. the power_kw fact).

LookalikeReason.description: Why buyers confuse the group's variants: overlapping specs in one generation, the same badge, or the same marketing name across markets.

LookalikeGroup.description: Variants that buyers confuse (Decision 019, variant finder spec §4). Built automatically from overlapping specs; staff overrides in data/manual.

built_by.description: staff = created or edited by hand; the pipeline keeps it as written.

generation_id.description: Set when all variants share one generation.

markets.description: Markets where the confusion applies (same-marketing-name); absent = everywhere.

label.description: Short label, e.g. 'ID.3 Pro: 58 vs 59 kWh'.

GenerationYearCheck.description: One outside production year compared with a generation boundary (T-059).

agrees.description: Within tolerance_years of the generation's year_start (start) or year_end (end).

label.description: The source's own label for the item (e.g. the Wikidata item label).

GenerationYearsCorroboration.description: Outside sources checking a generation's hand-entered years. Corroboration only: the years themselves never change (T-059).

KnownIssueCode.description: An RDW APK defect code with RDW's own Dutch label (dataset hx2c-gt7k). RDW publishes no English label.

per_100.description: Sampled cars with this defect per 100 sampled cars of this generation and first-registration year.

cohort_per_100.description: The same rate over all sampled BEVs of the same first-registration year (the comparison baseline).

KnownIssueCohort.description: APK defects for one generation and one first-registration year. Compare only with cohorts of the same first-registration year (Q-078).

few_reports.description: Too few defect reports to read anything into (young cohort or small counts): hide by default.

generations.description: Generations in the catalogue with a cohort this year.

sample_cars.description: All sampled BEVs of this first-registration year (every make).

KnownIssues.description: Optional 'Known issues' section from RDW APK defect data (T-059): aggregates per generation x first-registration year, never per car.

rate_basis.description: What the per-100 rates are per (plain sentence).

by_generation.description: Generation id -> cohorts, oldest first-registration year first.

ChargingStatsRelease.description: data/releases/<n>/charging_stats.json: aggregate charging statistics shipped next to the catalogue (Decision 012, T-059).

UsedPriceBand.description: Typical used asking-price band for a generation in one country. Only from sourced samples; shown only with >= 5 samples.

FeatureAvailability.description: Generic yes / no / not-disclosed for a car feature. Default not-disclosed; never inferred.

OnePedal.description: One-pedal driving (regen to a full stop): yes = default or one button; via-setting = a menu setting to turn on; no; not-disclosed.

OtaUpdates.description: Over-the-air updates: full = drive / battery / charging software too; infotainment-only = maps and media only.

SourceRef.description: Pointer to a Source listed elsewhere in the same file (e.g. the file's `sources`).

ProvenanceNote.description: Source, date, licence and confidence for a whole block of a release file (data rule 1).

retrieved_at.description: ISO date the source was read.

ClimateProvenance.description: ProvenanceNote plus how the station climate figures were made (T-034, Decision 041).

WeatherStation.description: Climate figures of one weather station, listed once per towns file (T-034).

months_mean_c.description: Mean of daily mean temperature per month, Jan..Dec, °C.

jan_p10_c.description: 10th percentile of January daily mean temperature, 1991-2020 (Decision 041).

Town.description: One town for the Trip fit town search (GeoNames, CC BY 4.0).

names.description: Name per UI language when it differs.

country.description: Lowercase country code as in the file name (uk for the United Kingdom).

station_id.description: Key in the file's `stations`; null = no station in range, the app uses its country default.

TownsRelease.description: releases/<n>/towns/<cc>.json: towns + January climate for Trip fit, one file per country (T-034).

climate.description: null = climate source gated or missing; towns ship without climate.

ConsumptionMatrixRelease.description: releases/<n>/consumption_matrix.json: per-variant consumption matrix (T-033). Every cell is a model output.

tests.description: Tests behind measured cells; source is a SourceRef into `sources`.

ShortlistRuleStatus.description: gap = field not in the data yet (factor scores 0.5, never a guess); calibrate = thresholds still to check; draft = not used for scoring yet.

ShortlistBand.description: Band of a scored variant (Decision 038). ruled-out = failed a gate; not-enough-data = more than half the weight unknown.

ShortlistBandThresholds.description: Score 0..100 at or above which a car is 'shortlist' / 'consider'; below = fallback.

ShortlistBands.description: Voltage class id (voltage_classes) or 'default' → thresholds. 'default' is used when the car's class has no row.

ShortlistGate.description: Hard rule: a known value under the floor rules the car out with `reason`. Unknown values pass and are listed as unknown.

sheet_field.description: Owner-sheet column used by the back-test only (internal).

rural_min_km.description: Floor used instead of min_km with the rural modifier.

reason.description: Plain words shown to users when the gate fails.

evidence.description: Why the rule exists (owner picks, research).

ShortlistFactor.description: Scored factor: value mapped linearly onto 0..1 between `poor` and `great` (clamped; poor > great means lower is better), times weight. Categorical fields (one_pedal, bidi, heat_pump, cooling_id) map by the scoring job's table and have no poor/great.

sheet_field.description: Owner-sheet column used by the back-test only (internal).

ShortlistAdjustment.description: Bonus (points > 0) or penalty (points < 0) with a plain-language rule.

FilterPreset.description: Explore filter a profile preselects, shown as a removable chip 'Set by your profile' (Decision 050).

PickerQuestion.description: One question of the profile picker (4 taps; ids shared with trip-fit §4, Decision 050).

skip_if.description: Skip this question when an earlier answer matches.

ShortlistModifier.description: 'Where you live' modifier (city / town / countryside): changes thresholds and weights of any profile.

picker.description: Picker answers that select this row: question id → accepted answer ids.

weight_steps.description: Factor id → steps up (+) or down (-); one step = × weight_step_factor, then renormalised.

use_rural_gates.description: Gates with rural_min_km use that value.

ShortlistRules.description: shortlist_rules.yaml: selection rules per profile (Decision 038), modifiers, add-ons and the picker (Decision 050). Rules are rows, not code.

review.description: true = agent-derived, owner still to confirm thresholds.

ShortlistScore.description: Score of one variant for one profile combination (T-069).

reasons.description: Reason codes: '+<factor>', '-<factor>', 'gate:<id>', 'bonus:<id>', 'penalty:<id>'; the app turns them into plain words.

unknown.description: Factors / gates without data (scored 0.5 or passed).

derived.description: Derived inputs (winter range, real Wh/km, ...), all estimates.

factors.description: Profile id → factor id → 0..1 value (null = unknown).

ShortlistScoresRelease.description: releases/<n>/shortlist_scores.json (T-069): editorial scores per variant and profile combination.

editorial.description: true: one owner's rules, opinion not fact.

EditorialVerdict.description: Owner's verdict from the sheet colour (data/editorial/README.md legend).

EditorialSheetValues.description: INTERNAL ONLY: values copied by hand from other sites into the owner's sheet. Calibrate the rules; never in a release, the app or open data (data rules 1-2). No published type contains this.

EditorialPick.description: Publishable owner pick ('Owner's pick'): verdict, tier, flags and notes, always labelled as one person's opinion (Decision 038). Has no sheet_values by design.

evdb_car_id.description: Cross-reference id only (link check); never used to copy data.

tier.description: Rank inside a group, lower is better (1.1-1.5).

EditorialPickSheetRow.description: INTERNAL row of menno-picks.yaml primary_car_picks: an EditorialPick plus sheet_values. Strip sheet_values to get an EditorialPick.

evdb_car_id.description: Cross-reference id only (link check); never used to copy data.

tier.description: Rank inside a group, lower is better (1.1-1.5).

EditorialEraPick.description: Row of menno-picks.yaml eras: model-level verdict per era (OTHER EVs tab).

EditorialUsedBudgetPick.description: INTERNAL row of menno-picks.yaml used_budget_bands_2025_07 (stale July 2025 used-market analysis).

EditorialPicks.description: data/editorial/menno-picks.yaml (generated by import_menno_sheet.py). Internal file: publish EditorialPick rows only.

RetiredIds.description: Ids that were published before and are gone now: old id → successor id, or null when there is no successor (T-062). The web app redirects old URLs with it.

RetiredIdsFile.description: releases/<n>/retired_ids.json (T-062). Becomes Catalogue.retired_ids once the pipeline test for the in-catalogue path lands with it (WS1); the pipeline switches on its own when Catalogue has the property.

UsedPriceBasis.description: band = from sourced price samples; estimate = list price x fitted depreciation curve (Decision 064).

UsedPriceYearBand.description: One build year's used asking-price band for a variant in one country (T-081, T-113).

date.description: Date of the samples (band) or of the published curve (estimate).

UsedPricesRelease.description: releases/<n>/used_prices.json (T-081, T-113, Decision 064). Top level allows extra summary keys (curves, backtest, status).
